reviews.text:
I hired SyncAir to disconnect my gas dryer and my barbecue from the gas line, and I couldn't be happier with the service. As a TSSA-licensed HVAC company, they handled the work safely and to code, which gave me real peace of mind when dealing with gas lines.

The technicians were professional from start to finish. They arrived prepared, worked efficiently, explained what they were doing, and left everything clean and secure. The job was done right, with no shortcuts.

I'd gladly use SyncAir again for any HVAC or gas work, and I'll be recommending them to friends, family, and neighbours. Highly recommended

I had a great experience with SyncAir! Paras arrived right on time and even called a few minutes before arriving, which was especially helpful with having a dog at home. He took the time to walk me through everything he was doing and explain why each step was important. He was kind, polite, professional, and honest throughout the entire visit. It’s clear he takes pride in his work and genuinely cares about providing great service. I will absolutely be calling Paras at SyncAir again for future maintenance and work and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, honest, and professional service!

We had multiple companies out to quote us for a new furnace but Paras’ quote was the most reasonable, for a great quality furnace, with minimal extra charges (some companies like to tack on the extras!) Paras was friendly, reliable, clean and punctual. He answered any questions we had and managed our expectations throughout the process. We will gladly call on him again when the time comes. Thank you, Paras!
Great price, friendly even after the job was done I notice something and he offered to come back and get it fixed. He’ll always make sure you are happy with the work and everything looks good to you

Very professional and excellent service. Paras installed my heat pump and did an outstanding job from start to finish. The work was clean, efficient, and done to a high standard. Pricing was also very reasonable. I would highly recommend him
